discovery.title: A landslide sent a tsunami 1,580 feet up an Alaska mountainside
discovery.summary: A newly reported study describes an August landslide-triggered tsunami in Alaska’s Tracy Arm fjord. Water and debris surged 1,580 feet up the opposite slope, underscoring the risks of fast-changing glacier landscapes.
discovery.why_it_matters: As glaciers retreat and slopes destabilize, remote fjords may pose sudden hazards to tour boats and other visitors. Better monitoring and warning systems could make a difference.

discovery.title: Anthropic says it will direct 5% of its shares to a public-benefit fund
discovery.summary: Anthropic announced a plan to commit 5% of its shares to a fund for public-benefit initiatives. The proposal raises questions about how AI-generated wealth might be shared and how such a fund would be governed.
discovery.why_it_matters: If implemented, the commitment could offer a high-profile model for directing some technology-company value toward public causes, while testing how corporate pledges translate into lasting benefits.

discovery.title: China names its first researchers for grants that can last 15 years
discovery.summary: Nature reports that China has selected the first researchers for a long-term grant program that begins with five years of funding and can be extended for another ten. The design contrasts with shorter grant cycles common in many research systems.
discovery.why_it_matters: Longer funding horizons may give researchers more room to pursue uncertain questions, but their effects on discovery and scientific careers will take time to assess.
